details: Interconnects newsletter; Tulu and open post-training work Nathan Lambert is an Australian politician. He has been a Labor Party member of the Victorian Legislative Assembly since 2022, representing the seat of Preston.

explainer.lead: Nathan Lambert is an Australian politician.

timeline.what: From 2019 to 2022, Lambert served as both an assistant and executive director for the Department of Jobs, Precincts and Regions in the Victorian Government.

At the 2022 Victorian state election, Lambert was elected but with a heavy swing against him from the Australian Greens and independent candidate and former Mayor of the City of Darebin Gaetano Greco. == References ==
